name: Monotonic Yang Dimension of Singletons plus Empty Set
proof: The singleton subfamily has Yang dimension $n-1$, giving the lower bound. Every subfamily has at most $n+1$ concepts, which alone gives only $n$; if it contains the all-zero function, Yang's delta-functions-plus-zero result gives value at most 1, while otherwise it is a subfamily of the singleton class and the generator-count bound gives at most $n-1$. Hence $\mathrm Y^*=n-1$.
references: \cite{yang2018homological}; derived using the established delta-functions-plus-zero and generator-count bounds
